overview.description: The Franklin Solana ETF (SOEZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund tracks an index to provide the price performance of Solana (ticker: SOL). The Trust offers an alternative to trading and holding SOL directly. SOEZ was launched on Dec 3, 2025 and is issued by Franklin Templeton.
